meaning: Measured cells only. A cell passes when every trial of it met every pre-registered gate (no tilt latch, no sustained undesired ground contact, foot support kept, height and commanded-rpy tracking, joint-limit contact, CoM margin, torque ratio, slip, return to nominal; push cells also recover). The counts and Wilson 95% intervals are the evidence; with 5 trials a perfect cell has a lower bound of about 0.57. Nothing here is labelled safe.
interpolation_rule: A requested (height, pitch) with a given arm pose may be treated as inside the envelope only if it lies within the convex region spanned by passing cells of that arm pose AND every grid cell neighbouring the request (the corners of the grid rectangle that contains it) passes. Otherwise it is unmeasured and not executable autonomously. Other arm poses, roll, yaw and combinations not in the grid are unmeasured.
roll: Excluded from the executable region: roll is weakly tracked (see probe cells); executable roll is fixed at 0.
world_frame_torso_attitude: recorded per segment in the trial files (rpy_world_achieved); not a gate

arm_rate_max.controller: plain WBCLocomotion arm PD, no gravity feed-forward
